target_claim: Absolute net convergence of the generalized sum indexed over all natural numbers to r implies that the series indexed from n=1 is absolutely convergent to the same value r.
source_quote: Since $\epsilon$ was arbitrary, it follows that the [[Definition:Series|series]] $\ds \sum_{n \mathop = 1}^\infty v_n$ is [[Definition:Absolutely Convergent Series|absolutely convergent]] to $r$ by definition.
